title: MMGE-reproducibility: code to reproduce the figures and tables of the ULYSSES multi-model global evaluation
description:
Python code to reproduce every figure and table of the manuscript Quantifying the Global Impact of Forcing Variability on Hydrological and Land Surface Model Performance: A Multi-Model Evaluation. The study evaluates four global hydrological and land-surface models (HTESSEL, JULES, mHM and PCR-GLOBWB), each driven by four precipitation forcings (EM-Earth, ERA5-Land, MSWEP and W5E5) over 1981–2019 at 0.1° resolution.

The scripts start from the processed datasets archived separately on Zenodo; download_data.py retrieves them and run_all.py regenerates all outputs.
